name: Tsukigahora Kirari
source:
Liked food: Sweet-glazed rice crackers
Disliked food: Parsley

A beautiful female author who made her debut as a novelist when she was a university student.
Her maiden work, "Processor," won the Novel Yotsuba Newcomer Novelist Award. 
It took the world by storm and has been made into a film, and her works after that have also all been hits.
Selfish and uninhibited. She has a carefree, does-whatever-she-pleases personality.
She makes a point to never sleep with the same man twice.
